div.div:
Pick one:
• RAG + evals: hybrid search, re-ranking, a proper eval set
• Agents: LangGraph or an agent SDK, MCP servers
• ML foundations: a full ML / deep learning course
• Plus: one cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) basics
